craft_notes: Sthāyin: Vismaya at unknowable workings, settling into plea. Colon→comma + landing colon (bloom stated, ward released). Rejected: 'keep' for 'ward' — ward is tenderer; kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: 'Lo Brahmā, lo Indra, lo sun and moon' — thy tendril
in flower, Bhava, that one: be our ward.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ayaṃ brahmā mahendro 'yaṃ sūryācandramasāv imau iti śaktilatā yasya puṣpitā pātv asau bhavaḥ

reads_against.argmap: 'This Brahmā, this Great Indra, these sun and moon' — thus blossomed as his power-creeper. → May Bhava, whose power-creeper blossoms as gods, protect.
c1_essence: Power-creeper blooming as gods protects; Mṛḍa errorless, reachless, praised everywhere.

l2.plain_english: 'Here is Brahmā, here the Great Indra, here sun and moon' — so his power-vine stands in bloom: may Bhava, that one, guard us.
